A regular rush of good news
The night supervisor noted a few words on gate queues at handover
Pet Travel Update

The Companion Animal Travel Desk at Aurelia Skyways is moving fast to keep animal journeys calm and orderly. Teams are checking carrier labels, confirming care notes, and making sure every change is logged in the desk ledger before the next handoff. Staff are using calm, humane handling throughout, with close attention to each pet's comfort and temperament.

Travelers should expect steady support when plans shift, because the cabin team is staying alert and the ground desk is pushing clear updates through the day. If you are sending a pet with Aurelia Skyways, keep documents ready and speak up early about special needs. Small details matter, and quick reporting helps us protect a smooth trip for every animal in our care.
